title: 주말 약속 정하기: 같이 갈까요? 같이 갑시다!
objective: You can make both forms, including ㄹ-stem verbs, choose the right one for the listener, and answer a suggestion.
summary: Learn to suggest doing something together with -(으)ㅂ시다 and -(으)ㄹ까요?, and to answer a suggestion.

task.title: Make and answer suggestions
task.line: Write the right form, choose the better sentence, or fix the mistake. Then check your answers.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a vowel + -ㅂ시다
forms.when: Use it with friends, people your age, or a group. Do not use it with teachers, bosses, or older people.
forms.exampleMeaning: Let's watch a movie together tomorrow.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a consonant + -읍시다
forms.when: Same use as -ㅂ시다. Add 읍 when the stem ends in a consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: There are seats. Let's sit here.

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a vowel + -ㄹ까요?
forms.when: Use it to ask what the other person thinks. It is soft and polite, so you can say it to anyone.
forms.exampleMeaning: Shall we go to the park together this weekend?

forms.form: Verb stem ending in a consonant + -을까요?
forms.when: Same use as -ㄹ까요?. Add 을 when the stem ends in a consonant.
forms.exampleMeaning: What shall we eat for dinner?

forms.when: Before -ㅂ시다, the ㄹ drops. Before -까요?, keep the ㄹ. Do not add 을 or 읍.
forms.exampleMeaning: Shall we make gimbap together? — Yes, let's make it.

forms.when: To say yes, use 좋아요 or -(으)ㅂ시다. To say no, say 미안해요, give a reason, and you can suggest another time.
forms.example: 가: 오늘 같이 운동할까요? 나: 미안해요. 오늘은 바빠요. 내일 합시다.
forms.exampleMeaning: A: Shall we work out together today? B: Sorry, I'm busy today. Let's do it tomorrow.

watchOut: 만들읍시다 (X) → 만듭시다 (O): For ㄹ-stem verbs, drop the ㄹ before -ㅂ시다. Never add 읍.
선생님, 같이 갑시다. (X) → 선생님, 같이 갈까요? (O): -(으)ㅂ시다 sounds too direct with teachers or older people. Use -(으)ㄹ까요? instead.
제가 문을 닫을까요? — 네, 닫읍시다. (X) → 네, 닫아 주세요. (O): 제가 ...(으)ㄹ까요? means 'Shall I ...?'. Only the speaker will do it, so don't answer with 'Let's'.
exercises: Fill in the blank with -(으)ㅂ시다: ① 버스가 왔어요. 버스를 ____. (타다) ② 식당이에요. 먼저 손을 ____. (씻다) ③ 날씨가 좋아요. 공원에서 ____. (놀다)
You are talking to your teacher. Choose the better sentence: (a) 선생님, 같이 점심을 먹읍시다. (b) 선생님, 같이 점심을 먹을까요?
Your friend says: 제가 사진을 찍을까요? Choose the right reply: (a) 네, 찍어 주세요. (b) 네, 찍읍시다.
Find and fix the mistake: ① 피곤해요. 오늘은 집에서 쉬읍시다. ② 저녁에 같이 밥을 먹까요?
Say yes to your friend. Complete the reply with -(으)ㅂ시다: 가: 토요일에 같이 테니스를 칠까요? 나: 네, 좋아요. 같이 ____.
answers: ① 탑시다 ② 씻읍시다 ③ 놉시다
① 쉬읍시다 → 쉽시다 ② 먹까요 → 먹을까요
